title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
abstract: arXiv:2610.18579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. translated_title: 读懂了却做错了：诊断智能体循环中“系统一”模型的决策失败
translated_abstract: “系统一”模型通过在单次前向中为一组给定选项打分来选择智能体的下一个动作。这使得它们快速且廉价，但当它们选择错误时却无从检查：究竟是模型误读了智能体所看到的内容，还是读对了却依然做出错误动作？我们从行为层面回答了这一问题。在由模拟环境、客服政策、工具使用、网页导航和编程等智能体决策状态构成的固定基准上，我们将每个“下一步动作”问题与关于同一状态的事实探针配对，各探针独立作答。在十七个快速系统和一个推理模型上，答案是一致的：大多数错误动作发生在正确阅读之后，且系统越准确，其错误中属于此类的比例越高。这些错误并非噪声；它们在各类系统中聚集于相同的状态。在被探测的事实可证明足以决定动作的情形下，即使模型读取了每一个事实，仍无法将它们组合起来……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于事实探针的行为诊断方法，发现智能体循环中“系统一”模型的大多数决策失败源于“读懂了状态却无法正确组合事实来行动”而非误读，且系统越准确这类错误占比越高。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a behavioral diagnostic using factual probes and finds that most decision failures of System One models in agent loops arise from correctly reading the state but failing to combine facts into the right action rather than misreading, with such errors concentrating on the same states across all systems.
